additional_info.subject: RE: ID0394969-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R2 170001564] Screen black & charging not possible CRM:00921001399
additional_info.body:
Hello Lorenz,
Thanks for the response.
We checked the charger on SCB, and it is currently online with no active error flags.
A site intervention should be planned to inspect the connections, as there may be a loose connection between KF1 and PH2. Please ensure that the DPP and USB connections used for the OC display and touch functionality are properly checked.
There is also a possibility that the DPP or USB cable may be faulty. We recommend swapping them with working cables to confirm the issue. During the site visit, please carry a spare HMI, DPP, and USB cables in case replacements are needed.
Kindly refer to the marked HMI schematic below and also review the attached Q-feedback for troubleshooting.
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109816666/si-e-q-feedback-q2302-sicharge-d-hmi-backlight-off-and-scrambled-image-due-to-router-emissions?dti=0&lc=en-WW
Please note, if the charger's DLogic is Gen2, the Q-feedback process will not apply. If all the checkpoints have been verified and the problem persists, then HMI replacement needs to be planned. Please refer below link for spare parts if needed.
